title: Staff Software Engineer
good_to_have_requirements:
Experience with message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar systems.
Familiarity with microservices and event-driven architectures.
Experience with asynchronous processing, queues, and streaming systems.
Exposure to Docker and Kubernetes.
Experience with monitoring, logging, alerting, and production observability.
Understanding of healthcare standards such as HL7, FHIR, or HIPAA.
Experience integrating with EHR/EMR systems or healthcare APIs.
Experience building high-scale, data-intensive, or AI-powered applications.
description: We are hiring a Staff Software Engineer for an AI-driven healthcare technology company transforming medical coding and revenue cycle management. You will set technical direction for core backend platforms, own the architecture of distributed, data-intensive systems, and mentor engineers across the team.
responsibilities: Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services and APIs.
Build high-performance systems with reliable integrations across internal and external services.
Design distributed systems focused on availability, fault tolerance, and graceful failure.
Implement asynchronous and event-driven workflows using queues and streams.
Work with SQL/NoSQL databases and optimize application and database performance.
Build and deploy cloud-based services using containerization technologies.
Implement monitoring, logging, and alerting to improve production observability.
Own services end-to-end, from development and code reviews to deployment and production reliability.
Set technical direction and architecture for core platform systems, and mentor engineers across the team.

keyword.main: ("staff software engineer" OR "staff engineer" OR "staff backend engineer" OR "principal software engineer" OR "principal engineer") AND (Python OR Node.js OR Golang) AND (Kafka OR RabbitMQ OR microservices OR event-driven OR Kubernetes OR Docker OR AWS OR GCP OR PostgreSQL OR MongoDB OR "system design" OR healthcare OR HL7 OR FHIR OR EHR) AND ("distributed systems" OR "high availability" OR scalability)
keyword.under_50: ("staff software engineer" OR "staff engineer" OR "staff backend engineer" OR "principal software engineer" OR "principal engineer") AND (Python OR Node.js OR Golang) AND (Kafka OR microservices OR event-driven OR Kubernetes OR Docker OR AWS OR GCP OR PostgreSQL OR "system design" OR healthcare OR HL7 OR FHIR)
keyword.over_500: ("staff software engineer" OR "staff engineer" OR "principal software engineer" OR "principal engineer") AND (Python OR Node.js OR Golang) AND Kafka AND (RabbitMQ OR microservices OR event-driven OR Kubernetes OR Docker OR AWS OR GCP OR PostgreSQL OR MongoDB OR "system design" OR healthcare OR HL7 OR FHIR OR EHR) AND ("distributed systems" OR "high availability" OR scalability)

assumptions: Language requirement is any one of Python, Node.js or Go, so searched as a single OR group.
Staff-level titles only; senior/lead left out since this level sits above senior.
College pedigree treated as a plus for backend roles, not a hard filter.
Healthcare terms (HL7, FHIR, EHR) added as plus-domain keywords; not mandatory.

must_have_requirements:
9+ years of experience in backend or software development, with a track record of technical leadership.
Strong proficiency in Python, Node.js, or Go.
Proven experience designing and owning large-scale, production-grade distributed systems.
Deep understanding of system design, scalability, reliability, and data modelling.
Hands-on experience with SQL and NoSQL databases at scale.
Experience mentoring engineers and raising engineering standards across a team.
Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Strong ownership, judgment, and communication with product and clinical stakeholders.
